_help: Intake file for one restaurant. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the scripts. Fill from the user's dropped description; leave anything unknown as null and the validator will tell you what is required. Weekdays are ISO: 1=Mon … 7=Sun. Times are 24h 'HH:MM' local to the restaurant.
_slug: ASCII kebab-case, unique across ALL countries, e.g. 'ta-piatakia-limassol'. Transliterate Greek names. Include the area if the name is generic.
_region_area: slugs from assets/config/countries.json — region is required, area is optional but strongly preferred (tourists search by area).
_booking_mode: instant = live slots (default) | request = pending until the restaurant confirms | phone_only = show phone/WhatsApp only
_translations: Both locales required. If the user only gave one language, write the other yourself and set is_machine_translated: true so the dashboard flags it for review. tagline ≤ 90 chars. description 80–200 words, tourist-facing, no marketing fluff.
_cuisines: 1–3 slugs from assets/config/cuisines.json, most specific first (the first one is primary).
_features: slugs from assets/config/features.json — only what the description actually supports.
_contact: Phones in E.164 (+357…). instagram as handle without @. google_maps_url can be used by scripts/geocode.mjs to extract coordinates.
_location: lat/lng required. If missing: node scripts/geocode.mjs "<address>" or paste a Google Maps link into contact.google_maps_url and run the same script.
_opening_hours: Display hours only (the 'open now' badge). Use several entries for split shifts or different weekend hours. Omit a weekday entirely = closed that day.
_service_periods: Bookable windows — this is what generates time slots. last_seating is the LAST slot offered, not closing time (closing minus turn time is a good default). Optional per-period: slot_interval_minutes, turn_minutes, max_covers_per_slot (pacing).
_tables: Table inventory drives availability. If the user gave real numbers, list them and set tables_are_placeholder false. If unknown, leave [] and the script seeds a placeholder set from the stated capacity (or 4×2, 4×4, 2×6 if no capacity known) and flags the restaurant for the owner to fix in the dashboard.
_photos: Optional. Leave [] to use every image in the intake folder in filename order (first = cover). Or list objects: {"file": "terrace.jpg", "alt": {"en": "…", "el": "…"}, "is_cover": true}.
_owner_notes: Internal only (e.g. 'owner is Maria, WhatsApp her for menu changes'). Never rendered.
